chunks: He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji'abi reported to me from Abu Muhammad Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id ibn Ziyad ibn Kananah, who reported from Ahmad ibn Isa ibn al-Hasan al-Hubi, who reported from Nasr ibn Hammad, who reported from Amru ibn Shimr, from Jabir al-Ju'fi, from Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir, peace be upon them both, from Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:

Indeed Jibraeel, peace be upon him, descended to me and said: Allah commands you to rise and declare the excellence of Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, as an orator before your companions, so that they may convey it to their posterity on your behalf. And He commands all the angels to hear what you mention. And Allah reveals to you, O Muhammad, that whoever opposes you regarding his command, for him is the Fire, and whoever obeys you, for him is Paradise.

So the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, ordered a caller and he called out: Congregational prayer! So the people gathered, and he went out and ascended the pulpit. The first thing he spoke was: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan. In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

Then he said: "O people! I am the bringer of good tidings, I am the warner, and I am the unlettered Prophet. I am conveying to you from Allah, exalted is His name, regarding a man whose flesh is from my flesh and whose blood is from my blood. He is the treasure of knowledge, and he is the one whom Allah chose from this nation, selected him, guided him, befriended him, and created me and him together. He made me excel through the Prophethood, and made him excel through conveying on my behalf. He made me the city of knowledge and made him its gate. He made me the treasurer of knowledge and the one from whom laws are derived, and singled him out with the successorship. He made his matter manifest, warned against enmity to him, drew closer those who befriend him, forgave his followers, and commanded all people to obey him. And He, Mighty and Majestic, says: Whoever takes him as enemy has taken Me as enemy, and whoever befriends him has befriended Me. Whoever shows hostility to him shows hostility to Me, whoever opposes him opposes Me, whoever disobeys him disobeys Me, whoever hurts him hurts Me, whoever hates him hates Me, whoever loves him loves Me, whoever has ill intention against him has ill intention against Me, whoever plots against him plots against Me, and whoever helps him helps Me. O people, listen to what he commands you and obey him, for indeed I warn you of Allah's punishment"

"On the Day when every soul will find all the good it has done present before it, and the evil it has done, it will wish there were a great distance between it and that evil. And Allah cautions you about Himself."

Then he took Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, by the hand and said: O assembly of people! This is the master of the believers, the Proof of Allah over all creation, and the fighter against the infidels. O Allah, I have indeed conveyed, and they are Your slaves, and You have the power to reform them, so reform them with Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the mercifuls. I seek forgiveness from Allah the Exalted for myself and for you.

Then he descended from the pulpit, and Jibraeel, peace be upon him, came to him and said: O Muhammad, indeed Allah, Mighty and Majestic, sends you greetings and says to you: May Allah reward you well for your conveying, for you have indeed conveyed your Lord's messages, advised your nation, pleased the believers, and humiliated the infidels. O Muhammad, indeed your cousin will face tribulations and many will face tribulations because of him. O Muhammad! Say at all times: "All praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds, and soon the wrongdoers shall know what place of return they will turn to."

key_terms.الوصية: Successorship, bequest (wasiyyah) - Ali's appointment as the Prophet's successor
key_terms.حجة الله: Proof of Allah (hujjat Allah) - Ali's authority over creation
key_terms.مدينة العلم: City of knowledge - the Prophet is the city and Ali is its gate

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about Ali ibn Abi Talib's excellence according to Kitab al-Amali?
ai.summary: This hadith records the Prophet Muhammad's sermon declaring the supreme excellence of Ali ibn Abi Talib by divine command. According to the narration, the angel Jibraeel descended and instructed the Prophet to publicly proclaim Ali's status before his companions. The Prophet ascended the pulpit and announced Ali as the treasure of knowledge, the gate of the city of knowledge, his divinely appointed successor, and declared that love or enmity toward Ali equates to love or enmity toward God Himself. The sermon culminates with the Prophet taking Ali's hand and presenting him as the master of the believers and the Proof of Allah over creation. This is a key hadith in Shia theology establishing the doctrine of Ali's wilayah (guardianship/authority).
